title: Make readiness and review gaps explainable
statement: As a delivery owner and reviewer, I can tell what is ready, what is missing, and why before approving the change.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Requirements, design, implementation trace, quality, review readiness, and completed review are separate derived gates with complete blocker details.
Intentional design or quality exclusions are revision-pinned, cited, and shown separately from covered and missing work; accepted delivery obligations cannot be silently excluded.
Work progress, a relation, a passing status, diff coverage, and reviewer approval cannot substitute for one another or for current immutable evidence.
The reviewer UI presents derived Requirements and Quality report sections, keeps the Decks surface separate, and deep-links from criterion paths to Items, tests, and exact code.
Queries and UI projections are bound to one Saga/source snapshot and reject stale cursors rather than mixing revisions.
Completed review requires the configured readiness gates plus current required report, slide, and test-case decisions; it does not imply external merge authorization.
